products.short_description: A layered Android Enterprise enrollment troubleshooting playbook — managed Google Play binding, enrollment-method path, endpoints, the can't-add-a-Google-account failure, dev-vs-prod differences, and post-AMAPI issues — a symptom-to-root-cause tree that gets devices enrolling. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Fix Android enrollment failures — especially "can't add a Google account"

Android Enterprise enrollment fails in maddening ways: the device won't add a Google account to Gmail or the device, web / account-driven enrollment works in dev but not prod, or enrollment stalls after an AMAPI migration. This solution is a layered enrollment diagnostic playbook: the managed Google Play binding health, the enrollment-method path, network/endpoint reachability, identity and account-add flow, dev-vs-prod configuration differences, and post-AMAPI-migration issues — a symptom→root-cause tree that gets devices enrolling and accounts adding.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the enrollment moving parts (managed Google Play binding, enrollment method, network endpoints, identity/account add, AMAPI vs legacy) and the diagnostic method.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Intune + Android Enterprise, admin roles, a reproducible test device, network visibility).
  • Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom→root-cause decision tree: can't add a Google account, web/account-driven enrollment works in dev but fails in prod, binding/connector errors, endpoint/proxy blocks, and post-AMAPI-migration failures — with the exact checks and fixes at each node.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Microsoft Graph / Intune automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (device enrolls, Google account adds, apps deliver) plus Best Practices for reducing enrollment-failure ticket volume; version-specific AMAPI behavior flagged to verify.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Android enrollments that stall — accounts that won't add, dev-works-prod-fails, post-AMAPI breakage — diagnosed by a repeatable decision tree to root cause, so devices enroll and Google accounts add.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ANDROIDDX-BindingHealth.ps1 — read-only health check of the managed Google Play binding / connector
    • ANDROIDDX-DiagnosticReport.ps1 — read-only enrollment/account-add diagnostic report mapping symptom to likely cause
    • ANDROIDDX-EndpointReachability.ps1 — test Google/Microsoft endpoint reachability and diff a dev-vs-prod config snapshot (read-only)
    • ANDROIDDX-EnrollmentReadiness.ps1 — read-only per-tenant/per-device Android enrollment readiness assessment
    • ANDROIDDX-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build/refresh the 'Enrollment Scope - Android' Entra ID group that bounds a pilot or expansion

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
